Sylvie: Postmortem follow-up from the DR rehearsal this morning. We observed three recurring patterns: route-table reconciler races, backup replication skew (eu-west and ap-south), and overly-aggressive healthcheck sensitivity. Need concrete owners, short deadlines, and a weekly tracking cadence.
Omar: I can take the reconciler race. Hypothesis: concurrent writer + eventual-consistency window causing transient mismatches. Quick plan: add publish-token, make reconcile idempotent, and add a delayed verification pass at +90s. ETA: 7 business days for code + staging canary.
Chen: I'll own backup replication telemetry and quick-restore pipeline. Proposal: nightly schema-only restore to a micro instance in the destination region, emit a restore_time metric, and alarm if replication lag > 10m twice in 24h. Target: 4 working days for pipeline + dashboard.
Lara: I'll update the restore runbook and schedule the dry-run game day. Suggest we run outside peak: Wed 06/09 04:00 PT. I'll add pre-flight checklist items (KMS cross-region keys, peering sanity, capacity reservation) and a 30m retro slot.
ops-bot: Created task 14477 "route-reconciler-fix" -> @Omar due in 7d. Created task 14478 "nightly-quick-restore" -> @Chen due in 4d. Created recurring task 14479 "weekly-failover-triage" -> oncall-rotation starting 06/05.
Jamal: Ops note on healthchecks: current probe is too strict (3s interval, 1 failure triggers). Recommend aggregate signals (tcp+http+app), add a 20s grace window, and require 2/3 probes failing for 30s before regional promotion. I can implement config knobs in 3 days.
Omar: Actionable checklist for reconcile: 1) publish-token write 2) post-publish reconcile w/ backoff 3) metric: route-diff-count by region 4) end-to-end canary probe hitting canary endpoint. Will open PR under ff/route-stability-2026 and include tests.
Chen: Quick restore script sketch: ```bash
SNAP=$(aws ec2 describe-snapshots --filters "Name=tag:cluster,Values=redwood-prod" --query 'Snapshots[-1].SnapshotId' --output text)
aws ec2 wait snapshot-completed --snapshot-ids $SNAP || exit 1
# attach to t3.micro in eu-west-1 (or ap-south-1), run basic app smoke checks, emit restore_time
```
Lara: Runbook pre-flight additions: 1) confirm KMS access 2) verify peering & route tables 3) reserve minimal infra 4) mute customer-facing alerts 5) contact matrix and escalation path. I'll push changes to Confluence and tag infra for review.
Jamal: For alerts I'll add: replication lag > 8m twice in 24h -> escalate to infra pager; healthcheck flaps >3 in 12h -> create a postmortem ticket. We'll surface trends in the weekly triage.
Sylvie: Ownership recap: Omar -> reconciler fix & canary (7d), Chen -> nightly quick-restore + dashboard (4d), Jamal -> healthcheck tuning (3d), Lara -> runbook + dry-run (06/09 04:00 PT), ops-bot -> recurring weekly triage. I'll mark items P0/P1 in the postmortem and publish the action tracker by 18:00 PT.
Omar: One ask: keep canary at 0.5% traffic and circuit-break to origin if error rate >1.5% sustained for 4m. Manual approval required to go beyond 5%.
Chen: We'll start with schema-only restores; promote to small-data if two consecutive runs pass. I'll post the first run logs to #incidents.
Lara: Confirming dry-run slot and reserving capacity. I'll also schedule the 30m retro immediately after.
Jamal: I'll add a healthcheck aggregation PR and tag @Lara for runbook references.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: daily reminders to owners at 09:00 PT until tasks closed.
Sylvie: Please confirm owners/timelines by EOD here. If no objections, I'll close the loop and push updates to the postmortem. :spiral_note_pad:
Omar: Confirmed.
Chen: Confirmed.
Lara: Confirmed.
Jamal: Confirmed.
Sylvie: Thanks all — publishing tracker at 18:00 PT and pinging owners.
